Hi all,

I reviewed SunRidge_Renewal_Draft_v1.docx. I've attached a marked-up version (SunRidge_Redline_v2.docx) with inline comments; summary of the key legal asks and our proposed positions: 

- Term / Early Termination: We can accommodate the 18-month term. Propose to keep existing early termination mechanisms but cap early-termination liability to the committed spend for the remaining term (standard).
- Data residency / access: SunRidge requested stronger language around audit logs and KMS—we can offer KMS integration for Private deployments, but hosted API will include standard audit logging; propose a limited SLA for export timelines.
- SLA Credits: We're open to a modest credit formula for uptime misses up to 5% annually; anything more will require escalated review and potential runbook changes.
- Capacity uplift: Order form to capture committed GPUs and burst allowances; we need exact monthly ramp profile to size capacity.

Ben's action items: I'll send the redline doc now and would like a quick alignment call to walk principal changes. Kimberly, please confirm the credit band we can offer without exec sign-off.

Regards,
Ben Carter

- We can accept the early-termination liability cap at committed spend but would like a 60-day notice window for any price changes tied to capacity increases.

Subject: Re: SunRidge renewal: SLAs & credits proposal

Elena — appreciate the clear note and the annotated order form. Quick responses to the two open asks: 

1) Export SLA for raw logs: we can commit to a 72-hour export window for hosted API logs as part of the renewal. A 48-hour SLA would require an operational exception and additional tooling (we can offer 48 hours for a dedicated/private deployment). If SunRidge is willing to accept 72 hours for hosted, we will include it in the MSA.

2) SLA credit band: we can offer an enhanced credit schedule for region-level availability dips that exceed 3% monthly, with a top-of-band credit up to 10% for sustained outages. Anything beyond that will be handled as a remediation plan (runbook + mitigation). This falls within our standard commercial playbook but I can escalate to get further latitude if needed.

If those tradeoffs are acceptable, Ben can insert the language and Alex will finalize the order form numbers. 

Kimberly Park
Director, Contracts & Risk
Redwood Inference
